description: Create a local Agent Change Passport for reviewer handoff. Returns Proof Contract boundary, changed-file scope, proof replay, proof sufficiency, reviewer action, next commands, and optional Baseframe assessment paths without executing proof commands.

base_ref.description: Optional git base ref for changed-file detection.

contract_path.description: Optional local Proof Contract JSON path for receipt validation.

emit_baseframe.description: Write the Baseframe ProjScan assessment artifact for this task.

feedback_path.description: Optional local feedback artifact path to apply as trust memory.

intent.description: Plain-language change intent to contract before or during work.

ledger_path.description: Optional local Proof Ledger JSONL path.

max_files.description: Maximum likely touched files to include. Default: 5, max: 25.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

output_path.description: Optional local passport JSON path under .projscan/passport.json or .projscan/passports/.

save_contract_path.description: Optional local path to write the generated Proof Contract in intent mode.

task_id.description: Optional Baseframe task ID when emit_baseframe is true.

name: projscan_passport
